items.title: My personal AI benchmark: “Generate an SVG of a frog with a Habsburg jaw”
items.whyItMatters: Practical eval of LLM generation quality — forcing a model to produce consistent SVG from an absurdly specific prompt tests capability far beyond most synthetic benchmarks.

items.title: On the non-use of AI in my writing process
items.whyItMatters: A veteran programmer's case for deliberately excluding AI from the writing process — relevant to any engineer weighing tooling tradeoffs in their own workflow.

items.title: AI financial advice is surprisingly good, especially if you ask right questions
items.whyItMatters: MIT Sloan finding that prompt quality dominates model quality for AI advice — a usability study that maps directly to how you'd design prompt templates in any tool.
